title: I like music, I hate exams
summary: **Без the** в общих высказываниях: **I like music, I hate exams**; игры и спорт, языки и предметы. Сравнение: **flowers / the flowers**.
ru:
## Общий смысл — без the
Когда говорим о чём-то **вообще**, о множестве предметов или веществе в целом, **the не нужен**.
> I like **music**, especially **classical music**. — Я люблю музыку, особенно классическую.
> We don't eat **meat** very often. — Мы не очень часто едим мясо.
> Life is not possible without **water**. — Жизнь невозможна без воды.
> I hate **exams**. — Ненавижу экзамены.
> I'm not very good at writing **letters**. — Я не очень хорошо пишу письма.
Нельзя: ~~I like the music~~ (если вообще музыку), ~~I hate the exams~~.

## Спорт и игры — без the
> My favourite sports are **tennis** and **skiing**. — Мои любимые виды спорта — теннис и лыжи.
> I play **football** every weekend.
Не говорим ~~the tennis~~, ~~the football~~.

## Языки и предметы — без the
> Do you think **English** is difficult? — Как думаешь, английский сложный?
> Tom's brother is studying **physics** and **chemistry**. — Брат Тома изучает физику и химию.
> I'm interested in **history** and **geography**.
Не говорим ~~the English~~, ~~the history~~ (когда это предмет вообще).

## flowers или the flowers?
- **Без the** — **вообще**: *Flowers are beautiful.* (все цветы)
- **С the** — **конкретные**: *This is a lovely garden. **The** flowers are beautiful.* (цветы в этом саду)
> I don't like cold **weather**. — Не люблю холодную погоду (вообще).
> **The weather** isn't very good today. — Сегодня погода не очень (сегодняшняя).
> We don't eat **fish** very often. — Мы нечасто едим рыбу.
> We had a nice meal last night. **The fish** was very good. — Вчера мы хорошо поужинали. Рыба была очень вкусная (та, что мы ели).
> Are you interested in **history**? — Вам интересна история (вообще)?
> Are you interested in **the history** of your country? — А история вашей страны (конкретная)?

## Простое правило
- Вообще о чём-то (любые, всякие) → **без the**.
- Конкретные, понятные собеседнику, особые → **the**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I like the music.~~ (вообще) → I like **music**.
- ~~The life is not easy.~~ → **Life** is not easy.
- ~~I hate the exams.~~ → I hate **exams**.
- ~~My favourite sport is the tennis.~~ → My favourite sport is **tennis**.
- ~~She studies the English.~~ → She studies **English**.
en:
## General ideas — no the
When we talk about something **in general** (all things of one kind, or a material), we don't use **the**.
> I like **music**, especially **classical music**.
> We don't eat **meat** very often.
> Life is not possible without **water**.
> I hate **exams**.
> I'm not very good at writing **letters**.
Not ~~I like the music~~, ~~I hate the exams~~.

## Sports and games
> My favourite sports are **tennis** and **skiing**.
No **the** before sports and games.

## Languages and school subjects
> Do you think **English** is difficult?
> Tom's brother is studying **physics** and **chemistry**.
> I'm interested in **history** and **geography**.

## flowers or the flowers?
- No **the** = in general: *Flowers are beautiful.*
- **the** = particular: *This is a lovely garden. **The** flowers are beautiful.*
> I don't like cold **weather**. (in general)
> **The weather** isn't very good today. (today)
> We don't eat **fish** very often. (in general)
> We had a nice meal. **The fish** was very good. (the fish we ate)
> Are you interested in **history**? (in general)
> Are you interested in **the history** of your country? (particular)

## Simple rule
- General (all, any) → **no the**.
- Particular, known to both → **the**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I like the music.~~ → I like **music**.
- ~~I hate the exams.~~ → I hate **exams**.
- ~~My favourite sport is the tennis.~~ → My favourite sport is **tennis**.
- ~~She studies the English.~~ → She studies **English**.
structure:
## Формулы
> **Вообще** (мн. число или неисчисляемое) → без the: **Flowers** are beautiful. · I like **music**.
> **Конкретное** → the: **The** flowers in this garden are beautiful. · I like **the** music in this film.

## Сравнение
| Вообще (без the) | Конкретно (с the) |
|---|---|
| I like music. | I like the music in this café. |
| Flowers are beautiful. | The flowers here are beautiful. |
| Do you like fish? | The fish was delicious. |
| I'm interested in history. | I'm interested in the history of my city. |
| English is difficult. | The English test was difficult. |

## Без the всегда
- **Игры и спорт**: tennis, football, skiing
- **Языки**: English, Russian, Kyrgyz
- **Предметы**: physics, history, chemistry, geography
